output.summary: A deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern North America, it has a short crooked trunk, spreading branches and leaves that turn red in autumn. Its dark blue-black fruit hangs until winter and becomes edible after frost; the Meskwaki eat it raw or cooked as jam.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit becomes edible after frost; the Meskwaki eat it raw and cook it into jam.
